- Jam: 2 portions at 14 g each, about 70 kcal
- Strawberry yogurt: about 150 g, about 130 kcal
- Peaches: about 120 g, about 60 kcal
- Strawberries: about 80 g, about 25 kcal
- Banana: about 120 g peeled, about 105 kcal
- Tea with milk: about 200 g, about 30 kcal
